'''Picodroids''' were [[Droid/Legends|droids]], presumably of the pico-scale. [[I-5YQ|I-Five]] suggested to [[Den Dhur]] that pico-droid engineers could fix the circuitry on the core of his ship. They were only available at [[Cybot Galactica/Legends|Cybot Galactica]] repair centers.<ref name="Jedi Healer">''[[MedStar II: Jedi Healer]]''</ref>
